company.shortDescription: Coris is a modern risk infrastructure for vertical Software-a-as-Service companies and payment processors.
company.description:
Coris is a modern risk infrastructure for vertical Software-a-as-Service companies and payment processors. Coris provides relevant alternative data about merchants for efficient and automated underwriting, as well as early warning signals before a merchant goes out of business. With native integration to Stripe Connect, Coris also provides a comprehensive Merchant Risk platform for risk teams to underwrite and manage risk of SMBs.

Coris is headquartered in Palo Alto, California and is backed by Y Combinator plus a slew of prominent investors.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $3,700,000, or 88.1% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,274,855 to $24,235,252, a 3.86x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 69 (+14 over 90 days) and market heat at 65 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
